newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: C & W Manila unit posts 20 pct rise in Q1 net.
newsitem.headline: C & W Manila unit posts 20 pct rise in Q1 net.

text.p: Eastern Telcommunications Philippines Inc (ETPI) said on Monday its first quarter net income increased by 20 percent to 120.138 million pesos from 100.06 million pesos in the same period last year.
ETPI vice chairman Luis Sison said revenues grew by 17 percent to 370.6 million pesos against 317.08 million pesos.
ETPI derives its income mostly from its international telecommunications services to the country's top corporations.
ETPI is 40 percent owned by Cable & Wireless plc, and 9.8 percent by Smart Communications Inc, an affiliate of holding firm Metro Pacific Corp
